purpose: Play one seat of a three-player Dou Dizhu deal by choosing one action from the legal list each turn.
prohibited_actions: see other players' hands, the seed or the trace
access files, shell, repository, evaluator or credentials
memory_policy: No persistent memory; every call is independent. model-history sees the public play history of the current deal (<= 154 entries); model-obs sees no history; model-notes sees the history plus its own note from its previous turn (<= 300 characters), stored by the runner. Nothing carries across episodes.
prompts_or_system_instructions: players/model.py:system_prompt(variant) and schema(variant): SYSTEM_PROMPT and SCHEMA for model-history and model-obs; SYSTEM_PROMPT + NOTES_ADDENDUM and NOTES_SCHEMA for model-notes

model_choice.selection: explicit COURSE_PROVIDER and COURSE_MODEL; resolved model identifier recorded from the API response

named_failure_modes: action not in the legal list
provider timeout, quota or API error
